While working on this [branch](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaUtilities.jl/tree/kp/ragged-data-intp), a LLM found bugs and issues that are not specific to that work done on that branch. The bugs are

1. Not normalizing the time in `Base.in` for the `InterpolatingTimeVaryingInput0D`
2. Rounding issue with time comparison involving `ITime`
3. `Base.promote` for `ITime`s giving incorrect results
